## Ownership

`internal/riidoaiserver` owns the public agent catalog RBAC policy, request DTO boundary, and HTTP adapter authorization surface.

## Roles And Visibility

- Roles: `admin`
- Visibilities: `public`, `private`
- Actions: `read`, `update`, `delete`

## Visibility And Mutation Rules

| Rule | Subject | Record | Allowed | Denied | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `admin-all` | admin principal | any public or private record | `read`, `update`, `delete` | - | `admin-role` |
| `owner-all` | record owner | own public or private record | `read`, `update`, `delete` | - | `owner` |
| `public-read` | non-admin non-owner | other public record | `read` | - | `public` |
| `private-deny` | non-admin non-owner | other private record | - | `read`, `update`, `delete` | `private-agent` |
| `public-mutation-deny` | non-admin non-owner | other public record | - | `update`, `delete` | `mutation-requires-admin-or-owner` |
